title: Brand Film v3 Client Review
summary: Client reviewed version 3 of the brand film. Key notes: warm colour grade needs adjustment, lower third timing tweak, music levels too loud over VO, licensing question for background track. Pacing in second half approved.

segments.speaker: Client
segments.text: The colour grade feels way too warm in the opening scene. It's not matching the brand.

segments.speaker: Client
segments.text: Can we move the lower third at around one minute fifteen to after the cut? It's overlapping the face.

segments.speaker: Client
segments.text: The music feels a bit loud overall. Hard to hear the VO.

segments.speaker: Client
segments.text: Do we have the rights cleared for the background track?

segments.speaker: Client
segments.text: The pacing in the second half is perfect, I love it.

segments.speaker: Client
segments.text: Actually forget what I said about the transition, it's fine.
